news.headline: Host a Side Event during TechCrunch Founder Summit Week in Boston
news.summary: Tap into 1,100+ founders, investors, and tech leaders converging on Boston for TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 (June 9) by hosting your own Side Event during Founder Summit Week (June 4-10). Perfect timing to amplify your brand, forge partnerships, or scout talent in one of tech's biggest gatherings.

news.headline: After killer quarter, Palantir CEO Alex Karp calls AI industry ‘Marxist’
news.summary: Palantir just posted $1B in quarterly profit, and CEO Alex Karp is doubling down on a bold claim: frontier AI labs can't be trusted with enterprise data. His message to companies considering these tools—proceed with extreme caution.

educational.title: What Actually Happens When You Buy a Stock
points: You're buying a tiny slice of real ownership in a company, not a lottery ticket
Your broker matches your order with a seller through an exchange in milliseconds
Stock price moves on collective belief about future profits, not just today's news
You make money two ways: the price rising, or dividends paid out over time
Owning one share still makes you a part-owner, with voting rights and all
